_comment: The complete list of things a skill can be allowed to do.
This file is the shared vocabulary. A skill's description uses these names to
say what it needs, and the watchers use the SAME names to record what it
actually did. Because both sides speak the same words, the app can compare
them directly - which is the entire basis of the security checks.
'brokered' means the app provides an official way to do it. 'proc.spawn' is
false because there is no official way to start another program: the only way
to do it is to go around the app, and that going-around is itself what gets
'scope_kind' says what shape the limits take - a task name, a file path, a
website address, or a setting name.

capabilities.description: Create, change or delete the user's to-do items.
Send a request out over the network.
Start another program on this computer.
